recordedProductIssues: Share panel recorded cropped at the top and bottom edges
Phone recording crops the share text at the top and the 'Stuck on the next screen' card at the bottom

defects.problem: The share panel is cut off at the top (checkbox row touches the frame edge) and clipped at the bottom under the Copy link row; it reads as cropped, not framed.
defects.fix: Give the panel margin inside the frame (re-crop with padding; no zoom) so the full card sits inside the canvas.

defects.problem: The phone image is clipped at both ends: the top text line ('November.') is sliced and the bottom helper card is cut mid-sentence. At feed size the phone's highlight is a few pixels wide.
defects.fix: Fit the full phone height inside the frame, and drop the sliced text with a clean crop at a natural boundary.

defects.problem: Hard layout change from the dark-text share panel to a white phone layout with no shared anchor; the right headline column changes width.
defects.fix: Reuse the same headline column position across both beats.

defects.problem: Phone occupies about a fifth of the frame width with a large empty right headline; the evidence is small and the headline dominates.
defects.fix: Rebalance widths so the phone is larger without cropping.

couldNotAssess: how the phone recording itself moves
oneLineVerdict: The honesty is good but the cropped share panel and sliced phone recording break the 'nothing out of frame' brief.
